newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish bond prices edge up on quiet market.
newsitem.headline: Danish bond prices edge up on quiet market.

text.p: Danish bond prices took back early losses, and a little more, on Friday but dealers expected limited activity for the rest of the afternoon and ahead of French and U.S. news early next week.

"The market will stay quiet up to the U.S. (May trade) figures this afternoon. At the same time Monday's French budget revision and Tuesday's speech from Fed Chairman Alan Greenspan will put a bit of a damper on the market," a dealer said.
At 1145 GMT the outgoing benchmark eight percent state bond due 2006 was up to 113.94, yielding 5.89 percent, from Thursday afternoon's 113.89.
